content:
tasha-finance: Arcadia Labs submitted a dispute for their April invoice. They claim platform fee charged during a 12-hour DR test should be waived. They attached the DR schedule.
ben-sales: Arcadia says our SE (Rohit) gave them a verbal nod on the call 2026-04-05 that the DR window would be exempt. No written confirmation in ticketing.
remo-cs: telemetry shows pool `arcadia-west` tagged `dr-test` from 2026-04-05T02:00Z to 2026-04-05T14:00Z. Reserved commit remained bound. They also spun up extra on-demand nodes for 1.5h after the test.
tasha-finance: invoice snippet:
```
INV-2026-812
reserved_commit 720h => $34,560
platform_fee => $8,640
support_enterprise => $2,880
```
They request removal of $8,640.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-812 generated 2026-04-07T11:02Z. Metering: reserved_hours=720. Tag history includes `dr-test` for 12h. No pre-approval record found.
ben-sales: customer is adamant — they recorded the call and will happily share the timestamped recording. If SE did imply approval we should honor? Need legal input.
claire-legal: contract check: SOW requires written approval for billing exemptions. Verbal statements aren’t binding. However, to preserve the account we can offer a one-time settlement. Recommend requiring customers to sign a short acknowledgement for the settlement and add clause to SOWs.
mike-fp: propose settlement options: (A) pro-rate platform fee for verified 12h => calc $8,640/720*12 = $144; (B) flat goodwill credit of $2,500 to close quickly; (C) full removal if we find written SE approval in logs (unlikely). Approve up to $2,500.
tasha-finance: quick math confirmed: pro-rate $144 (tiny). Customer will likely expect much more.
ben-sales: suggest $2,500 + require SE to add note in account and SE coaching to avoid recurrence. We'll also roll out a small UI flow to request exemptions.
claire-legal: agree to $2,500 conditional on signed acceptance email and a clause addendum added to the account.
tasha-finance: creating CM-2026-501 for $2,500 pending signed acceptance. Ticket #billing-ops-9710. Will set invoice status "pending_settlement".
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-501 recorded. Ledger hold until signed acceptance.
ben-sales: I'll send the offer and ask Arcadia to attach the call recording if they want us to review.
tasha-finance: closing loop when signed. Will also add detection rule to surface `dr-test` tags for next billing run. :white_check_mark:
